integrity: The full mathematical argument and two standalone exact-arithmetic verification programs are included. The same-model review makes no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact table only for Hamming weights one through eight; gap-clipping theorem all weights; no claim to improved large-weight asymptotics or to novelty of individual fixed-shift c_t values. Historical priority not independently established and unindexed equivalent formulations remain a risk.
title: Gap clipping and exact initial fixed-weight minima for Cusick's binary digit-sum bias
